axes.name: display_type_branch_form
axes.rationale: Both ordinary C forms encode the same observed branch around _invert; target branch is JE over the inversion path, so test if/goto lowering.

spec.semantic_summary: Compare the direct non-10 inversion guard with an explicit goto to the non-inversion path. The target branches on displayType==10 around one _invert call and then rejoins at the second row copy.
binding_evidence: Packet shows CMP displayType,10; JE skips a single far _invert call and rejoins at the second row copy.

promotion: NONE: independent rebuild and recipe review required
